rules: Do not call the difference between the pre-ZKP castVote gas and DIRECT castVote gas an isolated ZKP overhead; protocol and contract logic differ.
Do not directly compare the published 10-15 second end-to-end biometric/IoT workflow with local subsecond cast/proof stages as if they were the same measurement.
Gas is the primary on-chain cost metric; local latency includes process/RPC behavior under instant Anvil mining.
Warmups, pilots, failed campaigns, and aborted observations remain excluded exactly as frozen.
No silent outlier deletion or retry-based replacement is permitted.
No inferential regression or complexity fit is authorized by these publication assets.
Fresh-chain first vote is a distinct condition from the general accepted-ballot distribution.
Candidate-count gas difference of 12 gas is linked to calldata zero-byte composition, not isolated candidate-processing opcode cost.
Eligible-set N denotes occupied leaves; Merkle depth is fixed at 17.
M2 integrates Merkle snapshot, root, and target path; no isolated path-extraction timing claim.
M3-M5 include child-process overhead and fixed-depth effects; variation is descriptive, not N-dependent complexity.
The ZK vote circuit does not prove biometric matching; the pre-existing biometric subsystem remains an authorization subsystem.
